notes: inputs use: O,H,L,C,V (open, high, low, close, volume), OI (open interest), P (any price series). Params are defaults. Outputs are the series the indicator returns.

indicators.name: Simple Moving Average
indicators.definition: Arithmetic mean of the last N values. Smooths noise; lags price by about (N-1)/2 bars.

indicators.name: Exponential Moving Average
indicators.definition: Moving average that weights recent prices more heavily using an exponentially decaying factor.

indicators.name: Weighted Moving Average
indicators.definition: Moving average with linearly decreasing weights, newest bar weighted N and oldest weighted 1.

indicators.name: Double Exponential Moving Average
indicators.definition: Reduces EMA lag by combining an EMA with an EMA of that EMA.

indicators.name: Triple Exponential Moving Average
indicators.definition: Further lag reduction using three cascaded EMAs.
indicators.formula: TEMA = 3*E1 - 3*E2 + E3, where E1=EMA(P), E2=EMA(E1), E3=EMA(E2)

indicators.name: Hull Moving Average
indicators.definition: Fast, smooth moving average built from weighted MAs to cut lag and keep smoothness.

indicators.name: Smoothed Moving Average (Wilder / RMA)
indicators.definition: EMA variant with alpha = 1/N, used inside RSI, ATR and ADX.

indicators.name: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average
indicators.definition: Moving average that adapts its smoothing speed to the efficiency ratio: fast in trends, slow in chop.
indicators.formula: ER = |P_t-P_{t-N}| / sum|P_i-P_{i-1}|; SC = (ER*(2/(fast+1)-2/(slow+1)) + 2/(slow+1))^2; KAMA_t = KAMA_{t-1} + SC*(P_t-KAMA_{t-1})

indicators.name: Variable Index Dynamic Average
indicators.definition: EMA whose smoothing constant is scaled by the absolute Chande Momentum Oscillator (volatility/momentum).

indicators.name: Arnaud Legoux Moving Average
indicators.definition: Gaussian-weighted moving average with adjustable offset to trade smoothness against responsiveness.
indicators.formula: w_i = exp(-(i-m)^2/(2s^2)), m=offset*(N-1), s=N/sigma; ALMA = sum(w_i*P_i)/sum(w_i)

indicators.name: Zero-Lag EMA
indicators.definition: EMA applied to a de-lagged price series.

indicators.name: Tillson T3
indicators.definition: Six-stage cascaded EMA with a volume factor giving a very smooth, low-lag average.
indicators.formula: T3 = c1*E6 + c2*E5 + c3*E4 + c4*E3, with c from v-factor

indicators.name: Triangular Moving Average
indicators.definition: Double-smoothed SMA that puts the most weight on the middle of the window.

indicators.name: Volume-Weighted Moving Average
indicators.definition: Moving average weighting each close by its bar volume.

indicators.name: Least Squares Moving Average (Linear Regression Value)
indicators.definition: Endpoint of the least-squares regression line fitted over the last N bars.
indicators.formula: LSMA = intercept + slope*(N-1) from OLS of P on bar index

indicators.name: McGinley Dynamic
indicators.definition: Self-adjusting moving average that tracks price more closely in fast markets and avoids whipsaw.

indicators.name: Fractal Adaptive Moving Average
indicators.definition: EMA whose alpha is derived from the fractal dimension of price.

indicators.name: Jurik-style Adaptive Moving Average
indicators.definition: Low-lag, low-noise adaptive average; open-source approximations are commonly used since the original is proprietary.

indicators.name: Moving Average Envelope
indicators.definition: Fixed-percentage bands above and below a moving average.

indicators.name: MACD
indicators.definition: Difference between fast and slow EMAs, with a signal EMA and histogram; measures trend direction and momentum.
indicators.formula: MACD = EMA(C,fast)-EMA(C,slow); signal = EMA(MACD,sig); hist = MACD-signal

indicators.name: Percentage Price Oscillator
indicators.definition: MACD expressed as a percentage of the slow EMA, so it is comparable across instruments.

indicators.name: Average Directional Index (with +DI/-DI)
indicators.definition: Measures trend strength regardless of direction (0-100); +DI/-DI show direction.
indicators.formula: +DM=H_t-H_{t-1} (if > down move and >0); -DM likewise; DI=100*smooth(DM)/ATR; DX=100*|+DI - -DI|/(+DI + -DI); ADX=smooth(DX)

indicators.name: Average Directional Movement Rating
indicators.definition: Smoothed ADX comparing the current ADX with ADX N bars ago.

indicators.name: Directional Movement Index
indicators.definition: Directional components underlying ADX; crossovers signal trend changes.

indicators.name: Aroon
indicators.definition: Measures how recently the highest high and lowest low occurred within N bars.
indicators.formula: Up = 100*(N - bars since highest high)/N; Down = 100*(N - bars since lowest low)/N

indicators.name: Aroon Oscillator
indicators.definition: Difference between Aroon Up and Aroon Down.

indicators.name: Parabolic SAR
indicators.definition: Trailing stop-and-reverse that accelerates toward price as a trend extends.
indicators.formula: SAR_{t+1} = SAR_t + AF*(EP - SAR_t); AF increases by step on each new extreme point EP up to max

indicators.name: SuperTrend
indicators.definition: ATR-based trailing line that flips between support and resistance as price closes through it.
indicators.formula: basic = (H+L)/2 +/- mult*ATR; final bands ratchet in trend direction; flip when close crosses

indicators.name: Ichimoku Cloud
indicators.definition: Multi-line system showing trend, momentum and support/resistance via a forward-projected cloud.
indicators.formula: Tenkan=(HH9+LL9)/2; Kijun=(HH26+LL26)/2; SenkouA=(Tenkan+Kijun)/2 shifted +26; SenkouB=(HH52+LL52)/2 shifted +26; Chikou=Close shifted -26

indicators.name: Vortex Indicator
indicators.definition: Detects trend starts using upward and downward vortex movement relative to true range.

indicators.name: TRIX
indicators.definition: Rate of change of a triple-smoothed EMA; filters out minor cycles.

indicators.name: Mass Index
indicators.definition: Detects reversals by tracking range expansion ('reversal bulge').

indicators.name: Commodity Channel Index
indicators.definition: Measures deviation of typical price from its mean in units of mean deviation.

indicators.name: Relative Strength Index
indicators.definition: Bounded oscillator (0-100) comparing average gains to average losses.

indicators.name: Stochastic RSI
indicators.definition: Stochastic formula applied to RSI values to increase sensitivity.

indicators.name: Stochastic Oscillator
indicators.definition: Locates close within the recent high-low range.

indicators.name: Williams %R
indicators.definition: Inverted stochastic, ranging from -100 to 0.

indicators.name: Rate of Change
indicators.definition: Percentage change in price over N bars.

indicators.name: Momentum
indicators.definition: Absolute price change over N bars.

indicators.name: Chande Momentum Oscillator
indicators.definition: Momentum oscillator (-100 to +100) using raw up and down sums, unsmoothed.

indicators.name: True Strength Index
indicators.definition: Double-smoothed momentum normalized by double-smoothed absolute momentum.

indicators.name: Ultimate Oscillator
indicators.definition: Weighted blend of buying pressure over three timeframes to reduce false divergences.

indicators.name: Awesome Oscillator
indicators.definition: Difference between fast and slow SMAs of median price.

indicators.name: Accelerator Oscillator
indicators.definition: Awesome Oscillator minus its SMA; shows acceleration of momentum.

indicators.name: Detrended Price Oscillator
indicators.definition: Removes the trend by comparing price to a displaced SMA to isolate cycles.

indicators.name: Know Sure Thing
indicators.definition: Weighted sum of four smoothed rate-of-change values across timeframes.

indicators.name: Coppock Curve
indicators.definition: Long-term momentum indicator for identifying market bottoms.

indicators.name: Connors RSI
indicators.definition: Average of short-term RSI, RSI of up/down streak length and percentile rank of ROC.

indicators.name: Relative Vigor Index
indicators.definition: Compares close-open to high-low range, assuming closes are higher than opens in uptrends.

indicators.name: Relative Momentum Index
indicators.definition: RSI variant using momentum over k bars instead of 1-bar change.
indicators.formula: RSI formula applied to C_t - C_{t-k}

indicators.name: Schaff Trend Cycle
indicators.definition: MACD passed through a double stochastic to produce a faster cyclical oscillator.

indicators.name: Price Momentum Oscillator
indicators.definition: Double-smoothed rate of change.

indicators.name: Fisher Transform
indicators.definition: Transforms prices to an approximately Gaussian distribution to flag sharp turning points.

indicators.name: Inertia
indicators.definition: Linear regression smoothing of the Relative Volatility Index.

indicators.name: Squeeze Momentum
indicators.definition: Detects volatility compression (Bollinger inside Keltner) and plots a regression-based momentum histogram.
indicators.formula: squeeze_on = BB inside KC; mom = LinReg(C - avg(avg(HH,LL),SMA(C)), N)

indicators.name: Elder Ray (Bull/Bear Power)
indicators.definition: Measures buyer and seller strength relative to an EMA.
indicators.formula: Bull = H - EMA(C,N); Bear = L - EMA(C,N)

indicators.name: Elder Impulse System
indicators.definition: Colors bars by combined slope of EMA and MACD histogram (green, red, blue).
indicators.formula: green if EMA and hist rising; red if both falling; else blue

indicators.name: Balance of Power
indicators.definition: Gauges buyers vs sellers by close-open relative to range.

indicators.name: QStick
indicators.definition: Moving average of close-open candle bodies.

indicators.name: Chaikin Volatility
indicators.definition: Rate of change of the EMA of the high-low range.

indicators.name: True Range
indicators.definition: Largest of the current range and gaps from the previous close.

indicators.name: Average True Range
indicators.definition: Wilder-smoothed average of true range; the standard volatility and stop-distance measure.

indicators.name: Normalized ATR
indicators.definition: ATR as a percentage of close, comparable across instruments.

indicators.name: Bollinger Bands
indicators.definition: SMA with bands at k standard deviations; width reflects volatility.
indicators.formula: upper = SMA + k*sigma; lower = SMA - k*sigma

indicators.name: Bollinger %B
indicators.definition: Position of price relative to Bollinger Bands.

indicators.name: Bollinger Bandwidth
indicators.definition: Relative distance between the bands; low values signal a squeeze.

indicators.name: Keltner Channels
indicators.definition: EMA centerline with ATR-based bands.

indicators.name: Donchian Channels
indicators.definition: Highest high and lowest low over N bars; basis of turtle breakout systems.

indicators.name: STARC Bands
indicators.definition: SMA with ATR bands (Stoller Average Range Channels).

indicators.name: Chandelier Exit
indicators.definition: ATR trailing stop hung from the highest high (long) or lowest low (short).
indicators.formula: long = HH_N - mult*ATR; short = LL_N + mult*ATR

indicators.name: Historical (Realized) Volatility
indicators.definition: Annualized standard deviation of log returns.

indicators.name: Standard Deviation
indicators.definition: Dispersion of price around its mean.

indicators.name: Relative Volatility Index
indicators.definition: RSI applied to standard deviation instead of price change.
indicators.formula: RSI formula using stdev up/down depending on price direction

indicators.name: Ulcer Index
indicators.definition: Downside-only volatility based on depth and duration of drawdowns.

indicators.name: Parkinson Volatility
indicators.definition: Range-based volatility estimator using high and low prices.

indicators.name: Garman-Klass Volatility
indicators.definition: OHLC-based volatility estimator more efficient than close-to-close.

indicators.name: Rogers-Satchell Volatility
indicators.definition: Drift-independent OHLC volatility estimator.

indicators.name: Yang-Zhang Volatility
indicators.definition: Combines overnight, open-close and Rogers-Satchell variance; handles gaps and drift.

indicators.name: On-Balance Volume
indicators.definition: Cumulative volume signed by the direction of the close.
indicators.formula: OBV_t = OBV_{t-1} + V if C>C_prev; - V if C<C_prev; else +0

indicators.name: Accumulation/Distribution Line
indicators.definition: Cumulative money flow volume based on where the close sits in the bar's range.

indicators.name: Chaikin Money Flow
indicators.definition: Sum of money flow volume divided by sum of volume over N bars.

indicators.name: Chaikin Oscillator
indicators.definition: MACD applied to the Accumulation/Distribution Line.

indicators.name: Money Flow Index
indicators.definition: Volume-weighted RSI.

indicators.name: Volume-Weighted Average Price
indicators.definition: Cumulative average price weighted by volume, usually reset each session.

indicators.name: Anchored VWAP
indicators.definition: VWAP started from a user-chosen bar (e.g., swing low or earnings).

indicators.name: VWAP Bands
indicators.definition: Volume-weighted standard deviation bands around VWAP.

indicators.name: Ease of Movement
indicators.definition: Relates price change to volume to show how easily price moves.

indicators.name: Force Index
indicators.definition: Price change multiplied by volume, smoothed with an EMA.

indicators.name: Negative Volume Index
indicators.definition: Updates only on days when volume falls; tracks 'smart money' behavior.
indicators.formula: NVI_t = NVI_{t-1}*(1 + dC/C_prev) if V<V_prev else unchanged

indicators.name: Positive Volume Index
indicators.definition: Updates only on days when volume rises; tracks crowd behavior.
indicators.formula: PVI_t = PVI_{t-1}*(1 + dC/C_prev) if V>V_prev else unchanged

indicators.name: Price Volume Trend
indicators.definition: Cumulative volume scaled by percentage price change.

indicators.name: Volume Rate of Change
indicators.definition: Percentage change in volume over N bars.

indicators.name: Klinger Volume Oscillator
indicators.definition: Compares volume force to price trend to detect long-term money flow.

indicators.name: Volume Oscillator
indicators.definition: Percentage difference between fast and slow volume moving averages.

indicators.name: Twiggs Money Flow
indicators.definition: CMF variant using true high/low and Wilder smoothing.

indicators.name: Volume Profile
indicators.definition: Histogram of traded volume by price level, with POC (point of control) and value area.
indicators.formula: bin price range; sum volume per bin; POC=max bin; value area around POC holding ~70% volume

indicators.name: Market Facilitation Index
indicators.definition: Price range per unit of volume.

indicators.name: Open Interest Change
indicators.definition: Change in futures/options open interest; confirms trend participation.

indicators.name: Cumulative Volume Delta
indicators.definition: Running total of aggressive buy volume minus aggressive sell volume (needs tick or bid/ask-split data).

indicators.name: Pivot Points (Classic)
indicators.definition: Support and resistance levels from the prior period's high, low and close.

indicators.name: Pivot Points (Fibonacci)
indicators.definition: Pivot levels offset by Fibonacci ratios of the prior range.

indicators.name: Pivot Points (Camarilla)
indicators.definition: Tight intraday levels around the prior close.

indicators.name: Pivot Points (Woodie)
indicators.definition: Pivot variant that weights the close more heavily.

indicators.name: Pivot Points (DeMark)
indicators.definition: Pivot levels conditioned on the relationship between prior open and close.
indicators.formula: X = H+2L+C if C<O; 2H+L+C if C>O; H+L+2C if equal; PP=X/4; R1=X/2-L; S1=X/2-H

indicators.name: Fibonacci Retracement
indicators.definition: Horizontal levels at Fibonacci ratios between a swing high and swing low.

indicators.name: Fibonacci Extension
indicators.definition: Projection targets beyond a swing using Fibonacci ratios.

indicators.name: Gann Fan
indicators.definition: Angled trendlines from a pivot at fixed price/time ratios.
indicators.formula: price = pivot + slope*(bars since pivot), slope=ratio*scale

indicators.name: Swing Highs/Lows (Fractals)
indicators.definition: Bars whose high/low is the extreme of surrounding left/right bars (Williams Fractals when 2/2).
indicators.formula: H_t > max(H over left & right neighbours)

indicators.name: ZigZag
indicators.definition: Connects swing points that exceed a percentage threshold; filters minor moves. Repaints by design.
indicators.formula: Pivot confirmed when price reverses by >= deviation from the last extreme

indicators.name: Linear Regression Channel
indicators.definition: OLS line over N bars with parallel bands at k standard errors.
indicators.formula: line = a + b*t; bands = line +/- k*stderr

indicators.name: Price Channel / Range Breakout Levels
indicators.definition: Rolling highest high and lowest low used as breakout triggers.

indicators.name: Typical Price
indicators.definition: Average of high, low and close.

indicators.name: Median Price
indicators.definition: Midpoint of the bar's range.

indicators.name: Weighted Close
indicators.definition: Average with double weight on the close.

indicators.name: OHLC Average
indicators.definition: Mean of all four prices.

indicators.name: Heikin-Ashi Candles
indicators.definition: Smoothed candles that average price to make trends easier to read.

indicators.name: Renko Bricks
indicators.definition: Time-independent bricks that form only when price moves by a fixed size.

indicators.name: Log Return
indicators.definition: Natural log of price ratio; additive across time.

indicators.name: Percentage Return
indicators.definition: Simple percentage change.

indicators.name: Gap Size
indicators.definition: Difference between today's open and prior close.

indicators.name: Linear Regression Slope
indicators.definition: Slope of the OLS line fit over N bars; quantifies trend steepness.

indicators.name: R-Squared
indicators.definition: Goodness of fit of price to a linear trend (0-1).

indicators.name: Linear Regression Angle
indicators.definition: Slope converted to degrees.

indicators.name: Z-Score
indicators.definition: Distance of price from its rolling mean in standard deviations; common in mean reversion.

indicators.name: Rolling Correlation
indicators.definition: Pearson correlation of two series over N bars.

indicators.name: Rolling Beta
indicators.definition: Sensitivity of an asset's returns to a benchmark.

indicators.name: Rolling Skewness
indicators.definition: Asymmetry of the return distribution.

indicators.name: Rolling Kurtosis
indicators.definition: Tail heaviness of the return distribution.

indicators.name: Hurst Exponent
indicators.definition: Measures persistence (>0.5 trending), randomness (0.5) or mean reversion (<0.5).
indicators.formula: slope of log(R/S) vs log(n) (rescaled range)

indicators.name: Autocorrelation
indicators.definition: Correlation of returns with lagged returns.

indicators.name: Percentile Rank
indicators.definition: Share of values in the lookback window below the current value.

indicators.name: Efficiency Ratio
indicators.definition: Net price change divided by total path length; 1 means a perfectly straight move.

indicators.name: Fractal Dimension Index
indicators.definition: Estimates market roughness; near 1.5 means random, lower means trending.

indicators.name: Choppiness Index
indicators.definition: Scale from 0-100 where high values indicate sideways markets and low values trending.

indicators.name: Vertical Horizontal Filter
indicators.definition: Distinguishes trending from congested phases.

indicators.name: Hilbert Transform Dominant Cycle Period
indicators.definition: Estimates the dominant cycle length using Ehlers' Hilbert Transform.
indicators.formula: Hilbert transform based phase differencing (see TA-Lib HT_DCPERIOD)

indicators.name: Hilbert Sine Wave
indicators.definition: Sine and lead-sine of the dominant cycle phase for turning point detection.

indicators.name: Hilbert Trend vs Cycle Mode
indicators.definition: Binary flag: trending (1) or cycling (0).
indicators.formula: Based on dominant cycle phase rate and price vs trendline

indicators.name: Hilbert Instantaneous Trendline
indicators.definition: Smoothed average over the dominant cycle period.
indicators.formula: SMA over DCPeriod, then WMA smoothing

indicators.name: MESA Adaptive Moving Average (MAMA/FAMA)
indicators.definition: Ehlers adaptive MA whose alpha depends on the Hilbert phase rate of change.
indicators.formula: alpha = fast_limit/delta_phase, bounded; MAMA = alpha*P+(1-alpha)*MAMA_prev; FAMA = 0.5*alpha*MAMA+(1-0.5*alpha)*FAMA_prev

indicators.name: Cyber Cycle
indicators.definition: Ehlers cycle oscillator extracting the cyclic component of price.

indicators.name: Ehlers Super Smoother
indicators.definition: Two-pole Butterworth filter with minimal lag and aliasing.

indicators.name: Ehlers Instantaneous Trendline
indicators.definition: Low-lag trendline from a two-pole recursive filter.

indicators.name: Center of Gravity Oscillator
indicators.definition: Ehlers oscillator locating the 'balance point' of prices over a window.

indicators.name: Market Profile (TPO)
indicators.definition: Time-price-opportunity distribution of where price spent time in a session.
indicators.formula: count 30-min letters per price bin; value area = ~70% of TPOs around POC

indicators.name: Opening Range
indicators.definition: High and low of the first N minutes of the session; breakouts are common entries.
indicators.formula: max/min of H/L within first N minutes

indicators.name: Previous Period High/Low/Close
indicators.definition: Prior day/week/month key levels used as reference.

indicators.name: Gap Fill Status
indicators.definition: Tracks whether an opening gap has been traded back to the prior close.
indicators.formula: filled when price crosses prior close after gap

indicators.name: Order Blocks / Supply-Demand Zones
indicators.definition: Last opposing candle before an impulsive move; treated as institutional footprint zones (discretionary; rule definitions vary).
indicators.formula: last down candle before N-bar up-impulse exceeding k*ATR

indicators.name: Fair Value Gap
indicators.definition: Three-candle imbalance where bar 1 and bar 3 ranges do not overlap.
indicators.formula: bullish: L_{t} > H_{t-2}; bearish: H_{t} < L_{t-2}

indicators.name: Break of Structure / Change of Character
indicators.definition: Detects close beyond prior swing high/low (BOS = continuation, CHoCH = reversal).
indicators.formula: close > last swing high -> bullish BOS; first opposite break after trend -> CHoCH

indicators.name: Average Daily Range
indicators.definition: Mean of daily high-low ranges; used for target and stop sizing.

indicators.name: Relative Volume
indicators.definition: Current volume divided by its recent average.

indicators.name: Relative Strength (Price Ratio)
indicators.definition: Asset price divided by benchmark price; rising line means outperformance.

indicators.name: Relative Rotation Graph (RS-Ratio / RS-Momentum)
indicators.definition: Normalized relative strength and its momentum; plots rotation through leading, weakening, lagging, improving quadrants.

indicators.name: Relative Momentum Rank
indicators.definition: Cross-sectional rank of N-bar returns across a universe; basis for rotation strategies.

indicators.name: Advance/Decline Line
indicators.definition: Cumulative net advancing issues.

indicators.name: McClellan Oscillator
indicators.definition: Difference between fast and slow EMAs of net advances.

indicators.name: McClellan Summation Index
indicators.definition: Cumulative sum of the McClellan Oscillator.

indicators.name: Arms Index (TRIN)
indicators.definition: Ratio of advance/decline count to advance/decline volume; short-term overbought/oversold.

indicators.name: Percent of Stocks Above Moving Average
indicators.definition: Share of index constituents trading above their N-day MA.

indicators.name: New Highs - New Lows
indicators.definition: Number of 52-week highs minus lows.

indicators.name: Put/Call Ratio
indicators.definition: Options sentiment gauge; extremes are contrarian signals.

indicators.name: VIX Term Structure Ratio
indicators.definition: Ratio of near-term to 3-month implied vol; >1 (backwardation) signals stress.

indicators.name: IV Rank / IV Percentile
indicators.definition: Where current implied vol sits within its 1-year range (rank) or distribution (percentile).
indicators.formula: IVR=(IV-minIV)/(maxIV-minIV)*100; IVP=% of days IV below current

indicators.name: IV minus HV Spread
indicators.definition: Variance risk premium proxy.

indicators.name: Option Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, Rho)
indicators.definition: Sensitivities of option price to underlying, convexity, time, volatility and rates.

indicators.name: Max Pain
indicators.definition: Strike at which option holders collectively lose the most at expiry.
indicators.formula: argmin over K of sum(payout to all ITM calls and puts at K)

indicators.name: Put/Call Open Interest Ratio
indicators.definition: Ratio of open interest in puts to calls, a positioning gauge.

indicators.name: Futures Basis / Premium
indicators.definition: Difference between futures and spot price; reflects carry and sentiment.

indicators.name: Perpetual Funding Rate
indicators.definition: Periodic payment between longs and shorts on perpetual swaps; extremes signal crowding.

indicators.name: COT Net Positioning
indicators.definition: Net long/short positions of a trader group from the CFTC Commitments of Traders report.

indicators.name: Doji
indicators.definition: Open and close nearly equal; indecision.

indicators.name: Hammer / Hanging Man
indicators.definition: Small body at top with long lower shadow (>=2x body); hammer after downtrend, hanging man after uptrend.

indicators.name: Inverted Hammer / Shooting Star
indicators.definition: Small body at bottom with long upper shadow.

indicators.name: Engulfing (Bullish/Bearish)
indicators.definition: Second candle's body fully covers the previous candle's body in the opposite direction.
indicators.formula: bullish: prev red, curr green, O_c<=C_p, C_c>=O_p

indicators.name: Harami
indicators.definition: Small candle body contained within previous large body; potential reversal.

indicators.name: Piercing Line / Dark Cloud Cover
indicators.definition: Two-candle reversal closing beyond the midpoint of the previous body.
indicators.formula: curr close > midpoint of prev body (bull) or < (bear)

indicators.name: Morning Star / Evening Star
indicators.definition: Three-candle reversal: large body, small star body, large opposite body.
indicators.formula: c1 large, c2 small gapped, c3 closes beyond c1 midpoint

indicators.name: Three White Soldiers / Three Black Crows
indicators.definition: Three consecutive strong candles in one direction, each opening within the previous body.
indicators.formula: 3 consecutive up (or down) candles, rising closes, small shadows

indicators.name: Marubozu
indicators.definition: Candle with almost no shadows; strong conviction.

indicators.name: Spinning Top
indicators.definition: Small body with long upper and lower shadows; indecision.

indicators.name: Dragonfly / Gravestone Doji
indicators.definition: Doji with a long lower (dragonfly) or upper (gravestone) shadow.

indicators.name: Tweezer Top / Bottom
indicators.definition: Two consecutive candles with nearly identical highs (top) or lows (bottom).

indicators.name: Inside Bar / Outside Bar
indicators.definition: Bar fully within (inside) or fully engulfing (outside) the prior bar's range.
indicators.formula: inside: H<=Hp & L>=Lp; outside: H>Hp & L<Lp

indicators.name: Three Inside Up/Down
indicators.definition: Harami followed by a confirming third candle.
indicators.formula: harami then close beyond first candle's body

indicators.name: Kicker
indicators.definition: Gap reversal in which the second candle opens at or beyond the previous open in the opposite direction.
indicators.formula: opposite colours with gap beyond previous open

indicators.name: Double Top / Bottom
indicators.definition: Two peaks (or troughs) at similar levels separated by a trough; reversal on neckline break.
indicators.formula: two swing highs within tolerance; breakout of intervening low

indicators.name: Head and Shoulders (and Inverse)
indicators.definition: Three peaks with the middle highest; reversal on neckline break.
indicators.formula: swing sequence LS<H>RS with shoulders similar; neckline break

indicators.name: Triangles (Ascending/Descending/Symmetrical)
indicators.definition: Converging trendlines forming consolidation, breaking in either direction.
indicators.formula: fit lines to swing highs and lows; slopes converge

indicators.name: Flags and Pennants
indicators.definition: Short consolidation after a sharp move; continuation pattern.
indicators.formula: impulse > k*ATR followed by tight counter-trend channel

indicators.name: Rising / Falling Wedge
indicators.definition: Converging trendlines sloping the same direction; typically reversal.
indicators.formula: both trendlines slope same way, converging

indicators.name: Cup and Handle
indicators.definition: Rounded base followed by a small pullback; bullish continuation.
indicators.formula: U-shaped base with ~12-33% depth and shallow handle

indicators.name: Rectangle / Range
indicators.definition: Horizontal support and resistance consolidation.
indicators.formula: multiple touches at flat upper and lower bounds

indicators.name: N-Bar Breakout
indicators.definition: Close above the prior N-bar high or below N-bar low.

indicators.name: Elliott Wave Count
indicators.definition: Subjective impulse (5) and corrective (3) wave labeling; hard to backtest objectively, usually approximated with ZigZag rules.
indicators.formula: rule-based: wave 2 not below start, wave 3 not shortest, wave 4 no overlap with wave 1

indicators.name: TD Sequential
indicators.definition: Counts consecutive closes versus the close four bars earlier to flag trend exhaustion.
indicators.formula: setup: 9 consecutive C_t < C_{t-4} (buy) or > (sell); then countdown to 13

indicators.name: TD Setup (Simple)
indicators.definition: Running count of closes beyond the close N bars prior.

indicators.name: Consecutive Up/Down Closes
indicators.definition: Length of the current up or down streak.
indicators.formula: streak += sign(C_t - C_{t-1}) with reset on flip

indicators.name: Internal Bar Strength
indicators.definition: Where the close sits in the bar's range; low values often followed by short-term bounces.

indicators.name: Percent From Moving Average
indicators.definition: Distance of price from its MA as a percent.

indicators.name: RSI(2)
indicators.definition: Very short RSI used in Connors-style pullback strategies.

indicators.name: Pairs Spread / Hedge Ratio
indicators.definition: Residual of regressing one asset on another; z-score of residual drives stat-arb entries.

indicators.name: Engle-Granger Cointegration Test
indicators.definition: ADF test on regression residuals to check whether a pair is mean-reverting.

indicators.name: Mean Reversion Half-Life
indicators.definition: Expected bars for a deviation to decay by half under an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck fit.

indicators.name: Kalman Filter (Price / Hedge Ratio)
indicators.definition: Recursive estimator of a hidden level or dynamic hedge ratio.
indicators.formula: predict/update with process noise Q and measurement noise R

indicators.name: Rolling Sharpe Ratio
indicators.definition: Excess return per unit of volatility over a rolling window.

indicators.name: Rolling Sortino Ratio
indicators.definition: Like Sharpe but only penalizes downside deviation.

indicators.name: Drawdown
indicators.definition: Percentage decline from the running peak.

indicators.name: Historical Value at Risk
indicators.definition: Loss threshold not exceeded with the given confidence over a horizon, from the empirical return distribution.

indicators.name: Conditional VaR / Expected Shortfall
indicators.definition: Average loss beyond the VaR threshold.

indicators.name: Kelly Fraction
indicators.definition: Optimal bet fraction from win rate and payoff ratio (usually halved or quartered in practice).

indicators.name: Calmar Ratio
indicators.definition: Annualized return divided by max drawdown.

indicators.name: Volatility-Target Position Size
indicators.definition: Scales position so that portfolio volatility hits a target.

indicators.name: ATR Position Sizing
indicators.definition: Shares sized so that an ATR-multiple stop risks a fixed fraction of equity.

indicators.name: Day-of-Week / Month Seasonality
indicators.definition: Average return by weekday, month or turn-of-month window.

indicators.name: Session / Time-of-Day Filter
indicators.definition: Boolean flag restricting signals to given sessions; essential for intraday backtests.

indicators.name: Event Window Flag (earnings, expiry, macro)
indicators.definition: Marks bars within a window around scheduled events.

indicators.name: Sentiment / Fear-Greed Composite
indicators.definition: Composite of momentum, breadth, volatility, put/call and safe-haven demand (provider-specific).

indicators.name: Short Interest Ratio (Days to Cover)
indicators.definition: Shares sold short divided by average daily volume.

indicators.name: Price/Earnings Ratio
indicators.definition: Price divided by trailing or forward earnings per share.

indicators.name: Price/Book Ratio
indicators.definition: Price divided by book value per share.

indicators.name: EV/EBITDA
indicators.definition: Enterprise value divided by EBITDA; capital-structure-neutral valuation multiple.

indicators.name: Return on Equity
indicators.definition: Net income divided by shareholders' equity.

indicators.name: Piotroski F-Score
indicators.definition: 0-9 score of profitability, leverage and efficiency tests.

indicators.name: Altman Z-Score
indicators.definition: Bankruptcy-risk score from five financial ratios.

indicators.name: 12-1 Momentum (Factor)
indicators.definition: Return over the past 12 months excluding the most recent month; classic cross-sectional momentum factor.

indicators.name: Low-Volatility Factor
indicators.definition: Realized volatility used to rank stocks; low-vol tends to deliver better risk-adjusted returns.

indicators.name: Value Composite
indicators.definition: Rank average of valuation ratios (e.g., earnings yield, book/price, sales/EV).

indicators.name: Quality Composite
indicators.definition: Rank average of profitability and stability metrics (ROE, gross margin, low leverage).
